tei:div.tei:p: 255) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: 'gro 'dul 'phags pa'i me mchod las bzhi lhun grub bzhugs: 256) na mo padma kā ra ye:

rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: phyi rabs mos ldan skyes bu yis: 'gro 'dul 'phags pa'i dkyil 'khor du: bsnyen sgrub zab mo nyams blang tshe: kha skong me mchod brtson pa'i thabs: las bzhi lhun 'grub 'di ru bstan: skal ldan bu yis nyams su longs: sa ma ya: sa stegs gru bzhi dbus 'bur bar: las bzhi gang brtsams rang rang gi: thig dang srog yig sa bon bkod: de steng thab dkyil las mthun gyi: shing brtsigs phyogs rnams tshon gyis bsgyur: deng yi shar du me dar dang: shar lhor me sgron nub byang du: rlung g.yab 'dzugs shing mdun ngos su: 'bul rdzas gzhung bzhin 'du bar bya: bdag bskyed cho ga sngon song mthar: sreg rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni: oṃ swa bha wa= sogs: haṃ: rdzas kyi dngos po ma dag pa thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sreg rdzas rnams ngo bo ye shes kyi bdud rtsi la rnam pa phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas dwangs shing thogs pa med pa 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin lta bu nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum dang nam mkha' mdzod sngags lan bdun brjod: de nas las mthun gyi me sbar par bsam la: 257)oṃ agne dzwa la raṃ raṃ: me sbar: yaṃ yaṃ: brjod nas rlung g.yab: de nas sreg lha bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: 'byung lnga gnas dag yum lnga'i klong: lhun grub bde chen zhing khams dbus: me lha agne rā dza ni: dkar gsal phyag gnyis bgrang phreng 'dzin: dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras: pad nyi ra skyes gdan la bzhugs: de yi lto ba rab yangs klong: bhrūm̐ las lhun grub gzhal yas khang: bkod pa rab rdzogs pho brang dbus: padma thabs shes nyi zla'i steng: sogs nas gzhung gi bstod pa yan rdzogs mthar byon skyems 'bul ba ni: rtsa sngags mthar: oṃ a mṛ ta sarba pū dza la khā hi: lan nyer gcig gis 'bul:

de nas rdzas rnams 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: snang srid rnam dag mchod pa'i rdzas: ye shes bdud rtsi bla na med: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes phyir 'bul: bzhes nas tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag cing: don 'grub sku gnyis thob par shog: mar khu la: rtsa sngags mthar: oṃ a mṛ ta pū dza la khā hi: sham bcas lan nyer gcig gis 'bul: yam shing la: rtsa sngags mthar: oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣa ye swā hā: sham bcas 258) nyer gcig gis phul: rdzas 'dus la: rtsa sngags mthar: oṃ sarba dzñā na pū dza la khā hi: sham bcas nyer gcig gis phul: zhi ba la: nad gdon 'jigs brgyad sgrib gnyis bag chags dam tshig nyes ltung thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: rgyas pa la: ye shes yon tan tshe dpal gzi brjid thams cad puṣṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: dbang la: lha 'dre mi gsum zas nor longs spyod thams cad wā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: drag po la: rkyen phyi nang gi bar chad bdud bgegs log 'dren thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa: mtshams rnams su 'dod gsol ni: zhi ba la: hoḥ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs khyed rnams kyi zhal du bdud rtsi sreg blug gi mchod pa dam pa 'di phul bas bdag cag sgrub pa po'i rkyen phyi nang gi bar chad nad gdon 'jigs pa brgyad sogs zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod cig: rgyas pa la: hoḥ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs khyed rnams kyi zhal du bdud rtsi sreg blug gi mchod pa dam pa 'di phul bas bdag cag sgrub pa po'i tshe bsod dpal yon ye shes yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod cig: dbang la: hoḥ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs khyed rnams kyi zhal du bdud rtsi sreg blug gi 259)mchod pa dam pa 'di phul bas bdag cag sgrub pa po'i dbang du khams gsum srid gsum lha 'dre mi gsum zas nor longs spyod stobs nus dbang thang thams cad dbang du 'du ba'i phrin las mdzod cig:

drag po la: hoḥ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs khyed rnams kyi zhal du bdud rtsi sreg blug gi mchod pa dam pa 'di phul bas bdag cag sgrub pa po la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra gdon bgegs tshogs thams cad thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod cig: de nas bstod cing gtang rag ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i sprin: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: dgyes bzhes mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs: shapda ru pa sogs: dharma ma hā sarba pañtsa rakta ba liṃ ta khā hi: de nas gshegs skyems 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: thabs dang shes rab mnyam sbyor ba'i: rang byung bdud rtsi a mri ta: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsol: rtsa sngags mthar: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi: lan nyer gcig gis 'bul: de nas yam shing rdzas 'dus bdun re 'bul mthar bstod pa ni: 260) hūm̐: chos sku skye ba med pa las: rang bzhin lhun grub longs skur bzhengasaḥ thugs rjes gang 'dul skur snang ba: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la bstod: de nas dngos grub ni: hūm̐: byin rlabs dngos grub gter gyi bdag: yi dam lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa por: dbang dang dngos grub ma lus kun: da lta nyid du bstsal nas kyang: tshe 'dir rig 'dzin sa ru skyol: rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya wākka tsitta sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐: de nas lhag chad kha skong ba ni: hoḥ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gsan cing dgongasaḥ bdag cag ma rig rkyen dbang gis: cho ga ma dag lha ma gsal: nyes tshogs ci mchis bzod par gsol: tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsol: yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod: de nas gshegs gsol ni: oṃḥ ye shes lha tshogs dbyings su gshegs: dam tshig pa nyid rang la bsdu: brjod med gnyug ma'i gshis su āḥ

badzra mu: ye shes pa dbyings su gshegs: dam tshig pa rang la thim nas gnyis su med par gyur par bsam: de nas bsngo ba smon lam ni: hoḥ 'gro 'dul 'phags pa'i dkyil 'khor du: bsreg blugs mchod pa phul ba'i dge: 'gro kun sangs rgyas thob phyir 261)bsngo: kun kyang rang rig mngon gyur nas: mi 'gyur chos sku'i dgongs klong du: gdod ma'i gtan srid zin par shog: de nas bkra shis ni: hūm̐: rtsa gsum lha yi byin rlabs kyis: bdag cag sgrub mchog 'khor bcas la: 'jigs brgyad zhi dang tshe bsod rgyas: snang ba dbang bsdus log 'dren sgrol: las bzhi lhun gyis grub pa yi: bkra shis dam pa deng 'dir stsol: ces dang: gzhan yang bkra shis ci rigs kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o: sa ma yaḥ de ltar rnal 'byor ldan pa yis: me nyid ye shes lha ru shes: sreg rdzas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du: dmigs te phul ba'i bsod nams kyis: nyams chags bskang zhing tshogs gnyis rdzogs: gang 'dod las kyi phrin las 'grub: skal ldan bu yis dpal du shar: nyams su longs dang don gnyis 'byung: skal med rnams la 'di ma 'phrad: gter gyi srung mas gnyer gyis shig: dam ldan bu la 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: brda thim: : ces pa 'di yang shī la badzra ngor bde ba'i rdo rjes nyams chos yig ris su bris pa dge'o// 262)
